title: MEASURE_POINT_PROJECTION_ZERO_REFLECTION
selected_statement: For X : Profinite and μ : (measurePresheafObj X).obj (op Point), measurePointProjection X μ = 0 implies μ = 0.
proof_route: Expose the enriched-Hom/end structure of measurePresheafObj at op Point.
Use measurePointProjection as the identity-object enriched-Hom projection.
Exploit point-probe naturality and/or the full-faithful locally-constant/discrete functor.
Conclude zero of every component and then zero of the enriched section.
falsification_requirement: A refutation must exhibit a concrete nonzero μ at the protected measurePresheafObj type with zero measurePointProjection. Abstract ghost-summand models are not sufficient.
next_if_proved: Weighted one-point coverage/compatibility: recover equality of measurePointProjection for an arbitrary μ and the weighted all-true section built from its integral-basis coordinates, or prove a weaker statement sufficient after applying d at Point.
claim_boundary: Selection only. No theorem, one-point separation, d=0, mapping-out injectivity, coefficient solidity, P3 completion, or CM4 completion is admitted.
